question: Is there a club at Ramapo that does community service? I'm a senior and want to give back before I graduate
answer:
Yes. Rotaract Club is a service-driven organization that runs volunteer projects, fundraising initiatives, and service events; it partners with Rotary International. Email rotaract@ramapo.edu. [17] Social Work Club welcomes social work and non-social work majors to collaborate on social service projects; its ongoing projects include a book drive, an eyeglass drive, fundraisers, and other events. Email socialwork@ramapo.edu. [21] Both clubs are listed in the student-club directory. [19]

All clubs listed on the clubs page are open to all students, and clubs welcome new members. [20] You can also find community-service opportunities in the Daily Digest, In the Loop, and on Archway at https://archway.ramapo.edu/CCEC/club_signup, or contact the Civic and Community Engagement Center at ccec@ramapo.edu. [23, 24]

The Center for Student Involvement oversees student clubs. Contact csi@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7593, or visit SC-202. [20]
